snippet.title: MOBU - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Become a superpowered monk in MOBU, a fast-paced roguelite arena shooter where chaos escalates.

Fight waves of bouncing enemies raining from the sky, choose powerful upgrades, and create absurdly strong synergies to survive.
